w.doc: Mean energy per quantum W (PRD Eq. 1); 13.7 eV

field.doc: PandaX-4T drift field. Run0 ~93 V/cm (this default); Run1 ~84 V/cm (override per run).

liquid_xe_density.doc: Liquid xenon density (NESTv2.0 ER Wq / Qy / alpha)

p0_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Legendre coefficient p0. PRD Table II central value is 1.1; this is the data-matched value (within Table III's 1-sigma, |dp|~0.17 from Table II) that lands on the digitized Fig.17 manifold at xi_norm_er=150 -> LY/QY rms ~1% (exact Table II would give ~10% QY). See [[project_pandax_4t]].

p1_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Legendre coefficient p1 (PRD Table II -3.1; data-matched -3.04, within Table III errors)

p2_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Legendre coefficient p2 (PRD Table II 2.2; data-matched 2.32, within Table III errors)

p3_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Legendre coefficient p3 (PRD Table II -1.7; data-matched -1.74, within Table III errors)

a_er.doc: P4-NEST ER recombination-fluctuation scaling A^ER (PRD Table II)

d_er.doc: P4-NEST ER Run1 recombination shift. 0 for Run0; fitting the digitized Run1 LY+QY gives ~-0.028 (close to Table II's d_ER=-0.032). Both ER and NR Run1 prefer d~-0.03; the listed d_NR=-0.043 matches neither.
